title: Rotate a lab log safely
goal: Validate a rotation rule and retain protected records with bounded history.
challenge: Repair the invalid create mode in the dedicated lab rotation rule. Preview before applying it with an isolated state file; rotate a small fixture, prove the original records were retained and the new file has root:adm 0640 permissions. Do not invoke the global rotation configuration.

steps.command: printf "LAB_ROTATE retained record\n" | sudo tee /var/log/learning-lab/rotation.log; sudo chmod 0640 /var/log/learning-lab/rotation.log; sudo chown root:adm /var/log/learning-lab/rotation.log
steps.explanation: Create one small guest log. This is no filesystem exhaustion or throughput exercise.
steps.expected: One retained record in the protected file.

steps.explanation: Debug reports the invalid 0999 octal mode without rotating data or updating state.
steps.expected: A configuration error; original log remains intact.

steps.explanation: Change create 0999 root adm to create 0640 root adm. Keep rotate 2, the exact log path and all other rules.
steps.expected: Only the invalid creation mode changes.

steps.explanation: Apply only after successful preview. Force permits this tiny fixture to rotate below its 1k threshold; normal size behavior remains distinct.
steps.expected: One rotated file and a new empty active file.

steps.command: sudo cat /var/log/learning-lab/rotation.log.1; sudo ls -l /var/log/learning-lab/rotation.log*; sudo wc -c /var/log/learning-lab/rotation.log
steps.explanation: Inspect retained records and new ownership/mode. Do not repeat forced rotation merely to produce output; bounded history can eventually discard the oldest archive.
steps.expected: Original record remains in .1; active file is empty and root:adm 0640.

hints: 0999 is not an octal permission mode.
--debug previews; --force applies even when this small log has not reached 1k.
Use the dedicated state/config files so unrelated rotation jobs are untouched.
review: I demonstrated a failing preview without data change.
I retained the old record and verified the new file permissions.
coverage: Partial LPIC-1 108.2 logrotate (partial). Guest-only administration; completion records self-review, not verified assessment. No score.
